integrity: Derived from four-node cubic interpolation; exact symbolic identities and analytic positive-polynomial proof; representative numeric tests are not an infinite certificate.
scientific_limitations: Only fixed-ratio alternating-step BDF3 homogeneous zero stability; does not imply general variable-step, forced, nonlinear, or A-stability. The full text of the closest earlier spectral-radius paper was inaccessible; equivalence cannot be categorically excluded.
title: Sharp \(1/5\) Floquet damping for BDF3 on alternating grids
